about.title: About Me
columns: I am a full-stack engineer with 8+ years spent designing and scaling fault-tolerant web applications, event-driven services and high-performance interfaces for high-growth startups and enterprise teams.
I care about the whole path from a first sketch to a production dashboard: micro-interactions, performance budgets, database indices and high-availability topologies.
I have implemented containerised web applications, standardised design systems used across multiple squads, and zero-downtime deployment pipelines on AWS and Azure.
Currently open to senior full-stack and platform roles where clean architecture and measurable performance work matter.

featuredProjects.title: Project Alpha: AI-Powered Logistics Platform
featuredProjects.problem: Dispatch bottlenecks across 50,000+ daily deliveries caused driver delays and heavy idle-fuel waste.
featuredProjects.solution: Event-driven microservices with predictive AI routing and a sub-second live telemetry dashboard.
featuredProjects.impact: Route latency down 38%, fuel waste down 19%, $120k saved annually at 99.98% delivery reliability.

featuredProjects.title: Project Beta: E-Commerce Microservices
featuredProjects.problem: A monolithic checkout cascaded failures during flash sales, pushing cart abandonment above 40%.
featuredProjects.solution: Distributed checkout services in Go and Node.js with Redis queueing, idempotency keys and automated failover.
featuredProjects.impact: Zero downtime at 50k peak RPS, transaction latency under 80ms, checkout conversion up 26%.

featuredProjects.title: Project Gamma: Real-Time Collaboration Engine
featuredProjects.problem: Remote teams hit state desynchronisation and race conditions when editing complex flowcharts together.
featuredProjects.solution: A CRDT-based sync protocol over WebSockets, served from edge workers for sub-15ms regional updates.
featuredProjects.impact: Powers 100k+ monthly collaborative sessions globally with zero data loss and instant multi-cursor feedback.
